codeStyle.keyValueDelimiter.title: Code style: key/value delimiter
codeStyle.keyValueDelimiter.description: Delimiter between a key and its value, for new properties, sorting and the delimiter inspection.

codeStyle.spacesAroundDelimiter.title: Code style: spaces around the delimiter
codeStyle.spacesAroundDelimiter.description: Reformat File puts one space on each side of the delimiter.

codeStyle.alignDelimiters.title: Code style: align delimiters
codeStyle.alignDelimiters.description: Reformat File aligns the delimiters of the whole file.

codeStyle.keepBlankLines.title: Code style: keep blank lines
codeStyle.keepBlankLines.description: Reformat File keeps the blank lines between properties.

trailingSpaces.ignoreVisibleSpaces.title: Trailing spaces: ignore visible spaces
trailingSpaces.ignoreVisibleSpaces.description: Report only raw spaces and tabs, not escaped ones such as \t or \u0020.

incompleteProperty.ignoredSuffixes.title: Missing translations: ignored locales
incompleteProperty.ignoredSuffixes.description: Comma-separated locale suffixes (such as fr, de_CH) to skip when checking for missing translations.

inspections.useEllipsis.title: Report three dots used instead of an ellipsis

reportMissingKeysInCode.title: Report keys in code that no bundle declares
reportMissingKeysInCode.description: Warn on a literal key in getMessage, ResourceBundle.getString, #{key}, <spring:message> and <fmt:message> when the project's only MessageSource bundle (messages, ValidationMessages or i18n/*) doesn't declare it. Dynamic keys, default messages and bundles outside the project are never reported.
